title: warning_evaluate re-implements the node-id->slot scan that core/topology.odin's node_slot already provides
detail: The new eval writes a third copy of the id->slot linear scan instead of composing the existing node_slot helper (also duplicated in view.odin's bundle_strain_level). Drift between copies is a latent determinism hazard if the lookup rule ever changes.
recommended_fix: Call node_slot(t, p.at_node) (or_continue on !ok) inside the packet loop and accumulate into nload[slot]; keep one lookup implementation.
